commits.message: fix(auth): add server-side age >= 18 check in POST /api/auth/signup
fix(trust): wire selfie/video verify to real API instead of no-op onComplete
fix(rgpd): delete voice-messages and moments storage files on account delete
fix(infra): deduplicate supabase_env_trimmed warning to one log per boot
fix(seo): add landing-specific metadata for social sharing
fix(rgpd): add Art.9 consent checkbox for looking_for in /register
fix(design): replace indigo gradient in crystal page with brand violet tokens

priorities_implemented.approach: Created POST /api/profile/verify/selfie and /video routes with FormData upload to private 'verifications' bucket. Write profile_verifications row status='pending'. Rate limited 3/hour. Migration 049 adds status/storage_path/submitted_at columns and creates private bucket with RLS. UI wired to real APIs with error states.

priorities_implemented.audit_finding: FIX #2 — Age check serveur absent (P0 RGPD mineurs)
priorities_implemented.approach: Added numeric age validation after metadata extraction: if age < 18 return 400 before supabase.auth.signUp. Client-side min={18} remains as UX guard.

priorities_implemented.audit_finding: FIX #3 — Storage files orphans apres delete (P0 RGPD art.17)
priorities_implemented.approach: Replaced single-bucket avatar delete with loop over avatars + voice-messages + moments. Each bucket is best-effort. Response includes storageDeleted breakdown per bucket.

priorities_implemented.audit_finding: FIX #4 — looking_for orientation consentement art.9 (P0 RGPD)
priorities_implemented.approach: Added consentLookingFor boolean state + checkbox with Art.9 disclosure text. FormChoice only renders when consent ticked. signUp defaults to 'u' when no consent. Removed from stepOneInvalid gate.

priorities_implemented.audit_finding: FIX #5 — Crystal-ball empty state palette violation (P1 design)
priorities_implemented.approach: Replaced indigo bg-gradient-to-b from-[#1E1B4B] with radial-gradient rgba(139,92,246,0.18) + --color-bg CSS var. Text tokens updated to text-muted. Empty state copy updated with brand moon glyph.

priorities_implemented.audit_finding: FIX #6 — Meta tags absents landing (P0 CRO)
priorities_implemented.approach: Added page-level export const metadata with Montpellier CRO wording overriding layout defaults. OG + Twitter cards. opengraph-image.tsx auto-wiring preserved.

priorities_implemented.audit_finding: FIX #7 — Supabase env trimmed warning spam (P2 console)
priorities_implemented.approach: Added module-level _envTrimmedWarned boolean guard. logger.warn fires exactly once per boot instead of on every component mount.

next_steps: Run `supabase db push` to apply migration 049_verify_storage_bucket.sql (adds status/storage_path/submitted_at to profile_verifications, creates private verifications bucket with RLS)
Create the 'verifications' bucket in Supabase Storage dashboard with public=false if migration push is not available
Set SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in Vercel env if not already set (required for verify routes to upload to private bucket)
Wire moderator review queue: admin UI to review profile_verifications rows with status='pending' and flip to 'verified'/'rejected'
Optionally integrate Sightengine or face-api.js for automated confidence scoring on video submissions
Merge PR #50 after manual smoke test of the verify flow and age check
Apply same Art.9 consent gate to /signup-quick page (looking_for defaults to 'u' there already but checkbox disclosure is missing)
